findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "request_warm_intro" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_funds, get_fund, get_changes, get_fund_signals, request_warm_intro · Private data: search_funds, get_fund, get_changes, check_lp_coverage, search_lps, get_usage, send_feedback, request_warm_intro · Public sink: get_changes, send_feedback, request_warm_intro · Destructive: search_funds.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_funds, get_fund, get_changes, get_fund_signals, request_warm_intro · Private data: search_funds, get_fund, get_changes, check_lp_coverage, search_lps, get_usage, send_feedback, request_warm_intro · Public sink: get_changes, send_feedback, request_warm_intro · Destructive: search_funds

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_fund" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
